name: disable_fade_long
title: Disable 1: GetDisabled every game loop for 900 loops (about 13 s), with GameDaysPassed, and screenshots every 15 loops through the first 300; then Enable with screenshots every 10 loops (docs/design/script-function-params.md §3: when GetDisabled turns 1, and the fade's length and shape; about 1 min)
start: nvfstrip. Keep the game window in front (screenshots). Travels to the Prospector Saloon, faces its terminal, hides the HUD; never saved (capture_run.py --save nvfstrip). Each sample is GameDaysPassed x 100000 + 10 x GetDisabled.
